title: Youth Innovation & Venture Lab
summary: Building on our incubation heritage to transform grassroots youth ideas into scalable, investable African enterprises.
deliverables: Idea discovery & Human-Centered Design (HCD) sprints
Business-model development & prototype field validation
End-to-end incubation & acceleration curriculums
Pitch deck preparation, investor readiness & impact measurement

title: Research & Evidence Lab
summary: Generating actionable, empirical evidence on Africa's emerging socio-economic challenges through participatory field diagnostics.
deliverables: Applied policy research & socio-economic youth surveys
Rigorous baseline and endline evaluations
Institutional and stakeholder political-economy analysis
Evidence synthesis, peer-reviewed reports & policy briefs

title: Policy & Governance Lab
summary: Translating empirical research into actionable policies, regulatory sandboxes, and institutional public-sector reforms.
deliverables: Policy analysis, statutory review & regulatory design
Governance diagnostics & public-sector innovation audits
Stakeholder mapping & high-level policy dialogue facilitation
Model legislation drafting & policy implementation support

title: Policy Innovation Challenge
model: Research → Diagnosis → Proposal → Prototype → Policy Pitch
summary: Our unique product asking youth: 'What is one of Africa's most pressing problems, and what evidence-based solution can you design?'
deliverables: Challenge problem formulation across AI, Climate, Jobs, and Health
Youth-led systems research and root-cause diagnosis
Policy proposal drafting and prototype development
Policy pitch preparation and continental Policy Innovation Demo Day

title: Strategic Foresight & Futures Lab
summary: Strongly differentiating AfriYouth from conventional hubs by anticipating demographic, technological, and future-of-work horizons.
deliverables: Scenario planning (2030, 2040, 2050 possible futures)
Continuous horizon scanning & weak signal detection
PESTLE & STEEPV macro-environmental trend analysis
Emerging technology foresight (AI, green transition, automation)

title: Career & Professional Development Academy
model: Learn → Practice → Apply → Receive Feedback → Improve → Demonstrate
summary: Practical workforce transition platform moving youth from Education → Employability → Employment → Career Progression.
deliverables: Employability simulations with fictional job vacancy challenges
CV & cover letter customization, ATS optimization & LinkedIn branding
Professional Competency Assessment & real-world challenge portfolios
Leadership, AI skills, critical thinking & project M&E masterclasses

title: Impact & Learning Services
model: Theory of Change → Longitudinal KPI Tracking
summary: Solving the universal struggle of demonstrating whether socio-economic interventions actually achieve enduring results.
deliverables: Theory of Change formulation & logical frameworks
Custom M&E systems, KPIs & baseline outcome studies
Impact measurement & third-party verification
Learning reports, longitudinal dashboards & impact storytelling

title: Funding & Investment Readiness
model: Grant Intelligence → Financial Model → Due Diligence
summary: Cross-cutting fundraising service equipping youth organizations and ventures to mobilize sustainable catalytic capital.
deliverables: Grant opportunity intelligence & donor mapping strategies
High-conversion proposal & business case development
Investor readiness audits, financial modelling & pitch decks
Institutional partnership development & due-diligence preparation
